mediterranean pie bakery

in the heart of denmark

setting new brand identity

Challenges:

  • How to create overall atmosphere to appeal to the Scandinavian market, while preserving the bakery’s Mediterranean roots?

  • How to fairly price the custom and handmade goods to our customers?

  • How to recreate offers that speak better of our creation?

  • How to attract customers to our newely open business?

Solutions:

  • Market Adaptation — balancing Mediterranean authenticity with Scandinavian consumers.

  • Perceived Value — positioning homemade quality and craftsmanship as an essential part of the customer experience.

  • Product and Brand Alignment — creating a menu that communicates the bakery’s unique identity and culinary offering.

  • Digital-to-Physical Engagement — using social media to build awareness and inspire discovery, and convert it into in-store visits.
